CustomField.description: HANDOFF READINESS, not buyer quality. Whether MQL requires the account-match state to be unambiguous. This is NOT a requirement that an Account was matched: a clean No Match is a genuinely net-new prospect and passes. Only Review - two or more candidate Accounts - fails, because ownership and account context would be unresolved at the moment of handoff. Match state is owned by Lead.Match_Status__c.
CustomField.label: Require Unambiguous Account Match
